title: Ring-colimit comparison across prime localization with fixed algebra structures
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p\in\operatorname{Spec}(R)$, $A=R_p$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $K$ a field, and $\chi:\kappa_R(p)\to K$ a field embedding, where scheme residue fields are as in [def-weil-residue-field]. Let $c$ be a universal cocone of the ring diagram of etale residue triples over $(R,p,K,\chi)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], $C$ a commutative ring, and $e:c.\mathrm{pt}\cong C$ a ring isomorphism. Fix $A$-algebra structures on $K$ and $C$. Let $q\in\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and $\psi:\kappa_A(q)\to K$ satisfy that evaluation $A\to\kappa_A(q)\to K$ is the given $A$-algebra map. Assume its restriction along $R\to A$ is evaluation $R\to\kappa_R(p)\to K$, and the restriction of $A\to C$ is $e\circ c.\iota(t_0)$ for the identity triple $t_0=(R,\mathrm{id},p,\chi)$. Then there is a natural transformation $\iota$ from the local-base residue-triple ring diagram over $(A,q,K,\psi)$ to the constant diagram at $C$, such that $(C,\iota)$ is a universal ring cocone and for every local-base triple $t$ the composite $A\xrightarrow{t.\alpha}t.B\xrightarrow{\iota_t}C$ is the fixed $A$-algebra map. No separable-closure assumption is required.

proof.text: Express A as the filtered colimit of principal localizations R_s, for s outside p, using localization_colimit_principalLocalizations. In each R-triple B the corresponding pointed refinements B_s are again R-triples, and B localized at R outside p is their colimit.

Apply the object, morphism and equality clauses of etale_finite_data_descent to the affine inverse system Spec R_s. Every pointed etale A-algebra descends to an etale R_s-algebra, with pointing obtained by restriction of its map to K. Descend morphisms at a common stage and descend relations at a later stage. Isomorphisms between descents are handled by descending both directions and the two inverse relations. The field map inverts all denominators, so pointing compatibility survives these restrictions and refinements.

The descent and principal-refinement constructions give inverse identifications of ring cocones over the R-triples and A-triples, preserving vertices and maps between vertices. Transport c and its universal property through these identifications and e to obtain the natural transformation with vertex C. Naturality at the identity triple gives agreement on R, and uniqueness of maps from a localization gives agreement with the fixed structural map on A. This proves the displayed base-map equations and ring-colimit property without a strict-henselization assertion.

theorem etaleResidueTriples_primeLocalization_comparison
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ)) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (C : CommRingCat.{u}) (e : c.pt ≅ C)
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) C]
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
    (ψ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).residueField q ⟶
      CommRingCat.of K)
    (hψ : (ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).Γevaluation q ≫ ψ =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K))
    (hK : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K) =
        (ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ (Spec R).Γevaluation p ≫ χ)
    (hC : ∀ r : R, algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) C
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) r) =
        (c.ι.app ⟨R, 𝟙 R, inferInstance, p, by simp, χ, by simp⟩ ≫ e.hom).hom r) :
    ∃ (ι : etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram
        (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) q K ψ ⟶
        (Functor.const _).obj C),
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk C ι)) ∧
      ∀ t, t.α ≫ ι.app t =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) C)
